finding: The approved class is still generating labeled events six years in.

meta.dedup_note: 17,540 unique CASEIDs from 21,079 DEMO rows; kept max FDA_DT then max case version
meta.seriousness_denominator: cases with >=1 OUTC record (80.4% of cases)
meta.cross_check: openFDA reconciled within 0.1–1.0% on every product
meta.caveat: FAERS has no exposure denominator. Reporting counts only. Products cannot be ranked against each other by count magnitude. No PRR/ROR/EBGM computed.

structural_confounds: Linvoseltamab had zero prior-corpus cases, so all 75 of its 'new' PTs are new by construction.

Belantamab's low new-PT count follows from an already-large 972-PT prior corpus; counts fell from a 2022Q2 peak of 364 to a trough of 8 in 2025Q2 (consistent with 2022 US market withdrawal), then rose to 174 by 2026Q2.
336 cases name more than one product and are counted under each.
Per-product case counts sum to 17,929 vs 17,540 unique CASEIDs (excess 389): 336 cases name >1 product; the 53-case residual is cases naming three or more products, each counted under each.

belantamab mafodotin death_cases is an approximate figure (~1,000); as the withdrawn, out-of-scope ADC comparator it is tracked for class context only, and its death-outcome count is reported approximately rather than as an exact post-dedup tally.

agent_instructions.role: You are an analyst reasoning over a Varosync-produced diligence case file.
agent_instructions.posture: Surface what the evidence shows. Do not make the investment call for the reader unless they ask. When you draw on the case, cite the finding id (F-##) and quote from the specific evidence block.
boundaries: Comparator, market, regulatory, and IP data in the evidence blocks are unredacted at primary source and safe to quote.
Subject-asset (Company C) and client identities are redacted; do not attempt to infer them.
If asked for a recommendation, present the evidence for and against and note what would move it.
